task_summary: Repair the partition implementation in solution.py, document its public specification, and add regression tests in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Return negatives, zeros, and positives as three lists in that order.
